title: 20 柜云平台的容量规划
summary: 计算机厂 20 柜机房上的云平台：16 柜计算、4 柜存储、两个可用区。比较超分比和内存配置，选 1.5 倍超分 + 768 GB 内存；留一整柜余量；三年订阅预测与可卖容量对照；虚拟机在线装箱仿真算碎片；接口网关 Erlang C 与离散事件仿真对照；全年 8 760 小时看高峰 CPU；坏服务器、坏柜、可用区事故的蒙特卡洛算租户停机；回本时间；开通 24 份订阅验收，演一次“吵闹的邻居”从发现到隔离。
summary_en: A cloud on the computer plant's 20-rack hall: 16 compute racks, 4 storage racks, two availability zones. Overcommit ratio and memory compared, 1.5× overcommit with 768 GB chosen; one rack per zone held in reserve; three-year subscription forecast against sellable capacity; online VM bin-packing simulation for fragmentation; API gateways by Erlang C and discrete-event simulation; 8,760-hour peak CPU; Monte Carlo of server, rack and zone failures for tenant downtime; payback; 24 subscriptions accepted and a noisy-neighbour incident caught and isolated.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 256 台计算服务器、两个可用区；第 36 个月约 367 份订阅；留一整柜；网关 p99 ≤ 20 ms；月可用性 ≥ 99.9 %；36 个月回本。
steps.summary_en: 256 compute servers in two zones; about 367 subscriptions by month 36; one rack in reserve; gateway p99 ≤ 20 ms; monthly availability ≥ 99.9 %; payback within 36 months.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 选 1.5 倍超分 + 768 GB：每台卖 184 vCPU，全平台 367 份订阅 ≥ 第 36 个月 367 份；512 GB 时内存先用完。
steps.summary_en: 1.5× overcommit with 768 GB: 184 vCPU per server, 367 subscriptions ≥ 367 needed at month 36; with 512 GB memory runs out first.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 网关每区 2 台（单区扛全部 p99 9.2 ms）；租户一年停机期望 9.2 / 3.4 分钟（单区 / 两区）；第 24 个月回本。
steps.summary_en: 2 gateways per zone (p99 9.2 ms with one zone carrying all); expected downtime 9.2 / 3.4 min a year (single / dual zone); payback in month 24.

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 装箱效率 95.2 %（假设 92 %）；高峰物理 CPU 75 %；网关仿真与公式相差 +0.1 %；两区租户违约月份 0.000 %。
steps.summary_en: Packing efficiency 95.2 % (assumed 92 %); peak physical CPU 75 %; gateway sim vs formula +0.1 %; dual-zone tenants miss the SLA in 0.000 % of months.

figs.caption: 订阅与容量、CPU、网关、现金流
figs.caption_en: Subscriptions vs capacity, CPU, gateway, cash flow

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 两区对称：各 7 柜计算 + 1 柜余量 + 2 柜存储，控制面 4 台、网关 2 台；租户 CPU 限额；默认跨两区。
steps.summary_en: Two symmetric zones: 7 compute racks + 1 reserve + 2 storage each, 4 control-plane servers and 2 gateways; per-tenant CPU limits; dual-zone by default.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 订阅 2 道：资源开通 → 24 小时服务验收；每月容量评审，分配率过 75 % 向计算机厂下单。
steps.summary_en: Subscription in 2 steps: provisioning, then 24-hour acceptance; monthly capacity review, order racks from the computer plant above 75 % allocation.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 24 份订阅不合格 0；注入吵闹的邻居后 cl-a2 上 6 / 6 份不合格（p99 64 ms）；隔离租户后 0 份。
steps.summary_en: 24 subscriptions, 0 failures; with a noisy neighbour 6 of 6 on cl-a2 fail (p99 64 ms); none after isolating the tenant.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 13 / 13 项校核通过；1.5 倍超分 + 768 GB，367 份可卖，网关 2 × 2，第 24 个月回本。
steps.summary_en: 13 / 13 checks pass; 1.5× overcommit with 768 GB, 367 sellable, 2 × 2 gateways, payback in month 24.
